I'm GIDDY!\nI have a scintillating story for you!\pWould you like to hear my story?$
Oh…\nYou've left me feeling the blues…$
Also, I was thinking…$
That's about it, I think…\pWe should chat again!\nBye-bye!$
Hi, I'm the BARD.\nWould you like to hear my song?$
Oh…\nYou've left me feeling the blues…$
Oh, what a moving song…\nI wish I could play it for others…$

So?
How do you like my song?\pBut I'm none too happy about
the lyrics.\pHow would you like to write some
new lyrics for me?$
Oh…\nYou've left me feeling the blues…$
Thank you kindly!\nLet me sing it for you.$
Was that how you wanted your song\nto go?$
Okay! That's it, then.\nI'll sing this song for a while.$
Hey, yo! They call me the HIPSTER.\nI'll teach you what's hip and happening.$
But, hey, I taught you what's hip and\nhappening already.\pI'd like to spread the good word to\nother folks.$
But, hey, you already know a lot about\nwhat's hip and happening.\pI've got nothing new to teach you!$
Hey, have you heard about\n“{STR_VAR_1}”?\pWhat's it mean? Well…\nAsk your daddy or mommy, okay?$
Hello there, TRAINER!\nYou've got a wonderful smile, there.\pI have a hobby--collecting the profiles\nof POKéMON TRAINERS.$
So, how about it?\nMay I see your profile?$

You make your own profile by putting
together four words or phrases.\pHere, I'll show you an example of a
profile using four pieces of text.\pYou can switch those four pieces with
other text pieces any which way you\llike to make your own profile.\pThere are a lot of text pieces that
you can use.\pThey are arranged in groups like
POKéMON, lifestyles, and hobbies so\lit is easier to look them up.\pSo, first, choose the group of text
pieces to display a list of choices.\pThen, pick the choice you want.\pRepeat for the remaining text choices,
and you'll have your very own profile.$
Yes! Thank you!\nSo, let's see it, then.$
Oh, no, really?\pI imagine someone like you would have\na wonderful profile…$
Oh? You're not into it right now?\pWell, anytime is good by me!$
Hello there, TRAINER!\nYou've got a wonderful smile.$
May I see your new profile?$
Yes! Thank you!\pI hope it's even better than the profile\nyou showed me before.$
Oh, you like your profile the way it is.\pI don't blame you--it's a wonderful\nprofile the way it is now.$
F-fantastic!\pYour profile, it's wonderful!\nIt really says what you're about.\pWhy, anyone hearing this profile would\nbe captivated by you!\pThank you!$
Oh?\nYou know the secret saying!\pThat means you're now a fellow member\nof the MYSTERY EVENT CLUB!$
REPEL's effect wore off…$

Jackpot!$

Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE!\pHere, you may witness many kinds of
POKéMON rarely seen in HOENN.\pAnd, you'll see them in their wild,
untamed state in natural habitats.\pWhat's more, we've thrown open the
gates to POKéMON TRAINERS.\pYou're encouraged to catch POKéMON
for keeps!\pCome in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!$
Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE!\nIs it your first time here?$
Come in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!$

When you enter the SAFARI ZONE, you\nstart with 30 SAFARI BALLS for\lcatching POKéMON.\pThe SAFARI Game is over when you run\nout of SAFARI BALLS, or when you've\lwalked 500 steps.\pCome in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!$
Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE!\pAll you can catch for just ¥500!\nWould you like to play a SAFARI Game?$
Okay.\nPlease play another time!$
You don't have enough money.\nSorry.$
That will be ¥500, please.$
Here are your SAFARI BALLS.$
{PLAYER} received 30 SAFARI BALLS.$
We'll let you know when your game\nis over.\pSo, until then, enjoy yourself, please!\nOff you go on your wild excursion!$
Excuse me!\nYour PC BOX is full.$

Excuse me!
You seem to be without a {POKEBLOCK} CASE.\pYour SAFARI Game will be much more
fruitful if you use {POKEBLOCK}S.\pPlease come back with a {POKEBLOCK} CASE.\pYou may obtain a {POKEBLOCK} CASE from
the LILYCOVE CONTEST HALL.$
You still have time left. Would you like\nto exit the SAFARI ZONE now?$
Please enjoy the rest of your wild\nadventure!$
Okay.\pI'll take back your remaining SAFARI\nBALLS.\pThank you for playing.\nWe hope to see you again.$
Good luck!\pIf you need anything, don't hesitate\nto tell me, please!$
Did you know?\pIf you put a {POKEBLOCK} in that square box,\nPOKéMON gather around.$
I want to keep going deeper, but I\nforgot to bring a BIKE.\pSomething tells me that rare POKéMON\nlive in the outlying areas.$
Sometimes, when I toss a {POKEBLOCK} at \nPOKéMON, it gets ignored.\pDo POKéMON have likes and dislikes\nabout what they eat?$
Gasp… Gasp…\nI…made it out here…but…\pI'm exhausted… I don't have the\nenergy to catch POKéMON…$
I'm on a mission to find WATER POKéMON\nyou don't see in HOENN.\pDo you have any idea where the lake is?$
I'm going to catch a lot of rare POKéMON\nhere and trade them with my friends!$
I put a {POKEBLOCK} on the {POKEBLOCK} FEEDER.\nBut it seems to have disappeared.\pI guess POKéMON must have eaten it\nwithout me noticing.$
SAFARI ZONE TRAINER TIP!\pThrow {POKEBLOCK}S at wild POKéMON to make\nthem less likely to flee.$
“Relieve your tired feet.”\nREST HOUSE$
I don't have any {POKEBLOCK}S, but I caught\na good number of POKéMON.\pYou can improve your chances of making\na catch by getting closer to them\lbefore throwing a SAFARI BALL.$
If you use {POKEBLOCK}S, wild POKéMON won't\nbe so quick to run away.\pIt's not much use to give {POKEBLOCK}S to\nPOKéMON that don't flee easily.$
If you put a {POKEBLOCK} on the FEEDER,\nPOKéMON are attracted to it.\pI think POKéMON with the same sort of\nnature are drawn by a certain {POKEBLOCK}.$
This area is still under construction.\nIt's off-limits, sorry!$
The SAFARI ZONE's expansion project\nis finished now.\pWe hope you will enjoy the new area.$
This area is still under construction.\nIt's off-limits, sorry!$
Wow! Whee! I haven't seen any of\nthese POKéMON before!$
The POKéMON in this area are all\nnew to me.\pAnd I'm allowed to catch these rare\nPOKéMON! Too cool!$
The POKéMON around here seem to be\nfrom somewhere other than HOENN.$
I only have a couple SAFARI BALLS left.\pI'm having a hard time trying to\ndecide what I should catch.$
I heard that you can see PIKACHU here.\nWhere might one be?$
Oh, boo!\nI can't seem to catch anything!\pI'll end up wasting the admission\nprice if I don't catch something!$
If some vines drop down, this tree can\nbe climbed.$
If some vines drop down, this tree can\nbe climbed.\pUse the SECRET POWER?$

Do you want to register\n{STR_VAR_1}'s SECRET BASE?$

Up to 10 locations can be registered.\pDelete a location if you want to\nregister another location.$
Registration completed.$
Data has been unregistered.$

What would you like to do?$

Once registered, a SECRET BASE will not
disappear unless the other TRAINER\lmoves it to a different location.\pIf a SECRET BASE is deleted from the
registered list, another one may take\lits place.\pUp to ten SECRET BASE locations
may be registered.$
A shield of {STR_VAR_2} that marks winning\n{STR_VAR_1} times in a row at the BATTLE TOWER.$
A realistic toy TV. It could be easily\nmistaken for the real thing.$
A toy TV shaped like a SEEDOT.\nIt looks ready to roll away on its own…$
A toy TV shaped like a SKITTY.\nIt looks ready to stroll away…$
You may only make one SECRET BASE.\pWould you like to move from the SECRET\nBASE near {STR_VAR_1}?$
Moving completed.\pWould you like to use the SECRET POWER?$

What's that?
What am I doing?\pI'm thinking about making my own room
here using a POKéMON move.\pI know! I'll give you this TM.
Will you use it to make your own room?$

Find a big tree that looks like it might
drop some vines.\pUse SECRET POWER in front of the tree.
Some vines should get free and drop\ldown, so you can climb the tree.\pYou'll find a lot of space for putting
your favorite things.\pIt'll be your own secret room…
A SECRET BASE!\pYou should make one, too.\pAnother thing, you don't always have
to make your SECRET BASE in a tree.\pTry using SECRET POWER on rock walls
that have small indents in them.\pI'm going to look for other places, too.
Okay, bye!$
Oh, you don't want this?\nIf you change your mind, tell me, okay?$
Oh, you don't have any room for this.\pI'll hold on to it, so come back for it\nanother time, okay?$
There's a small indent in the wall.$
There's a small indent in the wall.\pUse the SECRET POWER?$
Discovered a small cavern!$
Want to make your SECRET BASE here?$
This is a test message.\nThis is a signpost.$
The massive downpour appears to\nhave stopped…$
The intense sunshine appears to\nhave subsided…$
Um, I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice.\nSnivel… This tension is getting to me…$
I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice!\nHere we come!$
I'm the no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice of {STR_VAR_1}!\nAccept my challenge!$
Um… I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice…\nDo you think someone like me can win?$
I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice!\nI'll let you challenge me!$
I'm horribly busy, but I also happen\nto be {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice.$
I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice.\nGlad to meet you!$
I serve as {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice.\nMay I begin?$
Eek! I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice!\nI'll do my best!$
Yeehaw! I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice!\nPut 'em up!$
I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s 1,000th apprentice!\nActually, I'm no. {STR_VAR_2}! Here goes!$
Yeah, I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice!\nLet's get rockin' and a-rollin'!$
Yippee-yahoo! I'm what you call\n{STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice!$
Cough! I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice.\nGood to meet you! Cough!$
This is nerve-racking…\nI'm the no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice of {STR_VAR_1}.$
I am {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice,\nand that's no lie.$

Are you… {PLAYER}?
Oh! Sniff…sob…\pOh! S-sorry…
I'm so nervous, I can't help crying…\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}, and I really look up
to you, {PLAYER}.\pI… I had this dream of one day meeting
you and asking you about POKéMON.\pPlease, please, {PLAYER}!
Please teach me about POKéMON!$
Oh… B-but…\nSnivel… Waaaaaaah!\pPlease!\nI'm begging you, please!$

Oh, really? You will?
Awesome! Wicked! Awoooh!\pOh… I'm sorry…
I'm so happy, I'm crying…\pUm… Then please tell me!
It's about the BATTLE TOWER.\pWhich would be better for me: Level 50
or the Open Level?$

{STR_VAR_1}?
Waaaaah!\pOh! I'm so sorry!
You've made me happy by choosing\lthe level for me, and it's made me cry…\pSnivel…
Thank you so much!\lPlease talk with me again!$

Wowee! You're {PLAYER}, aren't you?
You're awesomely strong, aren't you?\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}!
I just became a TRAINER!\pPlease, {PLAYER}!
Can you be my teacher and tell me\llots about being a TRAINER?$
Aww, why?\nOh, please? Pretty please?\lPlease be my teacher, please!$
Yay! Great!\pThe first thing I wanted to ask you is\nabout the BATTLE TOWER!\pThe Level 50 and Open Level Rooms…\nWhich would be perfect for me?$
{STR_VAR_1}, huh? That's true!\nI'll do my best there!\pIf we meet here again, please teach\nme something else, teacher!$

Um… Are you {PLAYER}?
My name is {STR_VAR_1}.\pI want to become a POKéMON TRAINER,
but I don't know what to do…\pSo I thought maybe I could ask you for
advice because you're so famous.\p{PLAYER}, could you give me advice?$
Oh, but…\pI sincerely want to become a POKéMON\nTRAINER!\pPlease, can you answer my questions?$

Thank you!
Here's my first question right away!\pThe BATTLE TOWER has two levels,
Level 50 and Open Level, right?\pWhich level do you think is more
suitable for me?$
Oh, the {STR_VAR_1} challenge?\nUnderstood!\pIf I have another question, I'll come\nback here for your advice!$

Oh? Huh? You're…
No, that can't be true.\pThere isn't any way that someone
like me could meet {PLAYER}.\p…You really are {PLAYER}?
I can't believe I'm talking to you!\pWhen something this good happens,
only terrible things will happen to me\lnow, I just know it…\p…I'm sorry…
I'm… {STR_VAR_1}…\pThere isn't anything special about
me that I can be proud of…\pI shouldn't even say anything about
myself because you'll forget…\pI had this dream that if I ever met
you, {PLAYER}, that maybe I could ask\lyou for advice as a TRAINER.\pBut I don't think you would agree
to that.\p…Or will you be so kind as to give
me advice?$

I knew it…\pIt had to happen because I'm such
a really boring nobody…\pBut I thought just maybe…
You won't reconsider, will you?\pBut I can't give up just like that.
I'll ask you while I'm still lucky!\pPlease, will you be so kind as to give
me advice?$

Really? I can't believe it!
I can't believe you'll advise me!\lI… I'm so happy…\pWhat I want to ask you is really
trivial, but I can't decide…\pAt the BATTLE TOWER, they let you
choose Level 50 or Open Level.\pWhich course do you think even I may
have a chance at?$

{STR_VAR_1}? Okay!
But do you really think someone like\lme would have a chance?\pI'll do my best, even though I don't
think it will work.\pThank you very much for spending
time with someone like me.$

Oh! You're {PLAYER}{KUN}, aren't you?\pI've heard that you're tough at
POKéMON!\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}!
I'll be your friend!\pDid you know?\pYou can't win at the BATTLE FRONTIER
if all you know is what they teach at\lthe TRAINER'S SCHOOL.\pI'm willing to listen to your advice.
You'll agree, of course?$
Huh? Why are you refusing me?\nIt's me who's asking you!\lYou have to reconsider!$

Okay, so there is this something.
I want you to decide it for me.\pYou know that the BATTLE TOWER has
Level 50 and Open Level Rooms?\pWhich do you think would be good
for me, {PLAYER}{KUN}?$

Okay, {STR_VAR_1} is suitable for me?
Thank you!\pKnowing that you made the decision,
{PLAYER}{KUN}, I won't be so upset if\lI lose.\pOkay, I'll look to you for advice again.
Bye!$

Oh, hi, there! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
I know you because you're famous!\lCall me {STR_VAR_1}! Glad to meet you!\pI'm a TRIATHLETE, so I keep myself
fit even while I raise POKéMON.\pI'm also involved with other things
like work, napping, ballroom dancing…\pBeing this busy, it's not so easy for
me to become a decent TRAINER.\pSo, I have a proposition!\pThere must be a reason why we met.
So, {PLAYER}{KUN}, how about sharing your\lwisdom with me every so often?$
Oh, but, please?\nA guy like me needs someone like\lyou, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pHonestly, I need your advice!$

Thank you! That's more like it!
So, let's start with an easy one!\pYou know about the BATTLE TOWER's
two courses, right?\lYou know, Level 50 and Open Level.\pMe being a busy guy, which one should
I gear up for?$
{STR_VAR_1}, huh? Okay, gotcha.\nI'll find time somehow and give it a go!\p…Whoops, I'd better go to work!\nThanks! See you around!$

No way! Uh-uh!
Are you maybe the real {PLAYER}?\pA-hah! Awesome! I'm {STR_VAR_1},
so pleased to meet you!\p{PLAYER}, you're very strong,
aren't you?\pEveryone's talking about you!\pOh! I just had this great idea!
I'll get advice off you, {PLAYER}!\lI'm sure it will make me tougher!\pIsn't it a great idea?
Please, I want your advice!$
Ahahaha, you can pretend to be mean,\nbut you can't fool me!\lYou really mean okay, don't you?$

Yay! I knew you'd have a big heart,
{PLAYER}!\pWhat should I ask you first?
…Oh, I thought of something!\pDrum roll, please!
The question I have is…\pIf I were to take a BATTLE TOWER
challenge, which way should I go?\pLevel 50 or Open Level?
Which suits me more?$

Oh-oh-oh!
{STR_VAR_1}, you say!\lThank you for a totally cool reply!\pI guess that's about all I wanted
to ask you today.\pLet's meet here again, okay?
Thanks!$

I beg your pardon, but…
Are you {PLAYER}?\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}, and I am delighted to
make your acquaintance.\pI have long been an admirer
of yours…\p… … … … … …\pUm… I hope you don't find this
request too much of a burden, but…\pMay I become your apprentice,
{PLAYER}?$

Oh…!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\p…I must have fainted from shock.
I'm sorry, I must have misheard you.\pPlease! Please say that you will
accept me as your apprentice!$

Oh… I'm delighted!\pI don't wish to waste your time,
so please advise me on this.\pI plan to take a BATTLE TOWER
challenge soon.\pHowever, there are two levels…\pWhich would be most suitable for me?
Level 50 or Open Level?$
{STR_VAR_1} is your choice!\nI see. I will do my best!\pThank you, {PLAYER}.\nI hope I can count on you again.\lPlease take care!$

Eek! Eek! {PLAYER}!
You spoke to me!\lI… I'm overjoyed!\pMe! My name is {STR_VAR_1}!
I just became a TRAINER!\pI'm delighted I met you, {PLAYER},
the big name in POKéMON circles!\pOh-oh-oh, I know!
May I ask a huge favor, {PLAYER}?\pPlease take me in as your apprentice!
I want to learn from you!$
Waaaah!\n{PLAYER} turned me down…\lIt… It's an invaluable experience!\p{PLAYER}, please! I want to hear\nan affirmative answer this time!\pI beg you for your guidance!$

Hieeeeh! {PLAYER} said yes!
{PLAYER} said yes!\pI won't be able to sleep tonight…
Thank you ever so much!\pThen, here's my question!\pAt the BATTLE TOWER, what is right
for me, Level 50 or Open Level?$
{STR_VAR_1}! Perfectly understood!\nI understand perfectly!\lI'm deliriously delighted!\pI hope you'll be willing to teach me\nsome more another time.$

Whoa! Could you be…
Might you be… {PLAYER}{KUN}?!\lThat strong and famous TRAINER?\lWell, hello, aren't I just the luckiest!\pHello, the name's {STR_VAR_1}!\pI've been on the lookout for
a POKéMON teacher.\pAnd with impeccably good timing,
along came you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pSo, there you have it, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Let me apprentice under you!$
Gwaaaah!\nYou're quite cool and tough…\pDon't be that way, please.\nI'm asking you!$

Oh, yeah! That's a solid reply!
Excellent, I might add!\pSo how about a first piece of advice
on the BATTLE TOWER?\pIf I were to go, what would be better?
Level 50 or Open Level?$
Uh-huh, {STR_VAR_1} it is!\nOK, A-OK!\lI'll go show my mettle, like, jam!\pAll right, I'll look to you as my mentor!\nAdios!$

Oh, hey, {PLAYER}{KUN}, right?
The police were looking for you!\p… … …
Of course I'm lying!\pMe, I'm {STR_VAR_1}. Despite the way
I look, I'm the POKéMON CHAMPION!\l…That's a lie, too!\pThis is no lie, though.
I'm not very good at battling.\pSo, how about you becoming my master
about all things POKéMON?$

If you're going to act cold like that,
I'll show you what I'll do!\pWaaah! Waaah! Waaah!
Hiccup!\pHahaha, that was my FAKE TEARS!\pCome on, will you please be
my POKéMON master?$

Yippee!
I'll buy you a boat for that!\pOf course I'm lying again!
But… Thank you, master!\pYou know how there's Level 50 and
Open Level at the BATTLE TOWER?\pI'm having trouble deciding which
level I should challenge…\pCan you decide for me, master?$

Okay, so {STR_VAR_1} is better!
I'll go to the other level, then!\pJust kidding!
I'll obey your teaching, master!\pThanks, master!
I hope you'll keep teaching me!$

A-H-O-Y!
And that spells ahoy, and it means hi!\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}, the rappin' SAILOR
am I!\pYour turn now, tell me a little about
yourself, give it a try!\pUh-huh, uh-huh!
{PLAYER}{KUN}'s your name,\land POKéMON's your game!\pAnd you're at a delicate age
when all the world's your stage!\pAnyway, I just want to say,
that you're the tenth TRAINER\lI've spoken to today.\pLet's make that a celebration!
Become my mentor for commemoration!$
But!\nYou have to work with me!\pDon't be such a tease!\nBecome my mentor, please!$

That's it!
{PLAYER}, you've got the spirit!\pSo here's my first question
that begs your suggestion!\pIt's about the BATTLE TOWER,
and it hinges on my power!\pLevel 50 and Open Level there be,
which is the one that's good for me?$
Okay, {STR_VAR_1} it is, you say!\nI'll go and take it on my way!\pIf it's advice I ever need,\n{PLAYER}, your word I'll always heed!$

Say, hey, aren't you {PLAYER}?
What should I do? Talk to you?\lWhy not? I'm already talking to you!\p{PLAYER}, are you surprised at me?
I'd better tell you who I happen to be!\p{STR_VAR_1} is what you can call me.
The brightest star in guitardom,\lthat's me!\pAre you receiving me?
You are receiving me!\pMy luck's at its best,
I'll hit you with a request!\p{PLAYER}, let me be your underling!
I want you to teach me everything!$
You're turning me down, then?\nI'll just have to ask you again!\p{PLAYER}, I beg to be your underling!\nI need you to teach me everything!$

Lucky, yeah, woohoo!
Should I pop a question to you?\pSince we're near the BATTLE TOWER,
how about a question about its power?\pOf the choices you see,
which is the right one for me?$
If {STR_VAR_1} is what you suggest,\nit must be the very best!\pWell, {PLAYER}, I have to roam free,\nbut don't you forget about me.\pSee you again, my smart friend!$

Oh, hi! You there!
Can I get you to massage my shoulder?\p…Yes, there! That's it!
Ouch, ouch! Oooh, that feels great!\pMy name's {STR_VAR_1}.
I take karate training, but my body's\lnot built to take the abuse…\pI decided I'll battle POKéMON and
toughen myself up.\pYou're {PLAYER}{KUN}, aren't you?
The POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMP?\pListen, can I get you to give me
